description: Modelling the Behavioural Side of Textile Waste Collection is published by Mendeley Data. The package compares conventional and smart-bin textile collection through agent-based and discrete-event simulations. Its stated coverage is Generic urban textile-waste scenarios. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is CC BY 4.0. The data are simulation outputs, not measured collection operations. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
